patch_description:
This version combines the memory-safe pressure-aware greedy placement from the current implementation with the simpler pressure-based ordering from the inspiration program. It builds placements using multiple deterministic orderings (pressure-first and size-first), retains the best feasible result, and then applies best-improving model moves and swaps.

The greedy stage evaluates the maximum KVPR after each candidate assignment, rather than only the current GPU pressure. The refinement stage improves the global maximum KVPR while preserving GPU memory constraints. Multiple construction orders reduce sensitivity to model ordering and help avoid memory fragmentation.
